entities.name: Dacian & Geto-Dacian Culture
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The Getae and Dacians inhabited the region between the Carpathians and the Dniester. Burebista's Dacian kingdom (82–44 BCE) briefly unified Dacian tribes. Trajan's conquest of Dacia (106 CE) brought Roman colonists and partial romanisation.
